svg.title: RQ4 Downstream Security Audit: Condition 1 vs. Condition 2
svg.desc: Controlled A/B security audit pipeline comparing baseline LLM vulnerability detection on raw minified JavaScript (Condition 1) against ReCall-enhanced detection with recovered library and function identities (Condition 2), followed by automated A/B comparison.
svg.text: RQ4 Downstream Security Audit: Condition 1 vs. Condition 2
